title: Merit Commercial Center - Lower Levels Shop Inventory (SB, LG, UG)
content: Comprehensive shop listings for the lower tiers of the Merit Commercial Center in Piassa. Semi-Basement (SB) options include 11 shops of 22 m² with direct road access and 16 shops of 32 m² with corridor access. Lower Ground (LG) options feature Road Access (18 shops of 22 m², 2 shops of 16 m², 8 shops of 11 m²) and Corridor Access (15 shops of 32 m², 17 shops of 16 m², 14 shops of 11 m²). Upper Ground (UG) options feature Road Access (17 shops of 22 m², 2 shops of 16 m², 8 shops of 11 m², 19 shops of 16 m², 14 shops of 11 m²) and Corridor Access (22 shops of 32 m²).

title: Merit Commercial Center - Upper Levels Shop Inventory (Floors 1-3)
content: Detailed commercial shop availability across the upper floors of the Merit Piassa development. Floor 1 options feature Road Access (20 shops of 22 m², 2 shops of 16 m², 8 shops of 11 m²) and Corridor Access (22 shops of 32 m², 18 shops of 16 m², 14 shops of 11 m²). Floor 2 options feature Road Access (18 shops of 22 m², 8 shops of 11 m², 2 shops of 16 m²) and Corridor Access (22 shops of 32 m², 18 shops of 16 m², 14 shops of 11 m²). Floor 3 options feature Road Access (18 shops of 22 m², 2 shops of 16 m², 8 shops of 11 m²) and Corridor Access (16 shops of 32 m², 18 shops of 16 m², 14 shops of 11 m²).

title: Piassa Site Construction Progress Updates
content: Official on-site structural progress logs for the Merit Piassa build. The latest milestone update recorded on March 11, 2026, details three distinct validation vectors: 1. Main Structural Progress footage tracking framework advancement on the core blocks. 2. Site Movement metrics capturing structural development and street-level access from surrounding blocks. 3. Wide Aerial Overviews detailing site mapping and neighborhood integration.
